item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Shows `before(x=\"sky?\")` succeeds with `dspy.settings.lm is lm` while `before.p.lm is None`, then `opt.compile(before, trainset=trainset)` is caught as `ValueError` and asserts both required substrings."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines one `metric` and one `trainset` once, and reuses the same `opt`/`trainset` setup for both compile attempts; only LM attachment changes between attempts."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `after.set_lm(lm)` before the second compile and explicitly proves the predictor-local LM changes from `None` to the same `DummyLM` instance via assertions."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Constructs `DummyLM({\"sky?\": {\"y\": \"blue\"}})`, i.e. dictionary mode keyed by input text, and comments that it is repeatable for multiple offline calls."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `finetune_lms` to return `{(lm, None): lm}`, checks `mocked.assert_called_once()`, then asserts the compiled module is `after`, has `_compiled is True`, and `compiled.p.lm is lm`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
